import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PureWindowsPath

import volume_disk
from run_volume import FAILURES, READ_ONLY, check_state, controlled, expected_markers, numbers
from run_volume_admission import CORRUPT, STARTUP_FAILURE


ROOT = Path("/mnt/c/Users/simon/AppData/Local/nieuw-os/copilot-tests/volume-ce02f093/repo")
SOURCE = "2c410004daceb557f5501e58270d5b315744f1a6eb22d44499d45bc31bef41b7"
HEAD = "ce02f093627a2c0b9808461ac821d4ebcd8dbb5f"


def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def local(windows):
    original = PureWindowsPath(windows)
    assert original.drive.lower() == "c:"
    path = Path("/mnt/c").joinpath(*original.parts[1:])
    assert path.is_relative_to(ROOT)
    return path


matrix_path = ROOT / "native-build-fetch4/volume-admission/matrix.json"
gate_path = ROOT / "native-crashgate-fetch5/volume-gate.json"
assert sha(matrix_path) == "4474ed16520e8edcface5dcbae3371d4412290b1f97afd16b3f8a29c849b3435"
assert sha(gate_path) == "41f88c6d4c98989be8cfddfaefa6a71d94e72a6f4a4e8dc8f494d3638a8db70a"
matrix = json.loads(matrix_path.read_bytes())
gate = json.loads(gate_path.read_bytes())
assert matrix["passed"] is True and matrix["source_unchanged"] is True
assert matrix["source"]["head"] == HEAD
assert matrix["source"]["source_sha256"] == gate["source_sha256"] == SOURCE
assert gate["passed"] is True and gate["status"] == "completed"
assert len(matrix["runs"]) == 10 and len(gate["stages"]) == 9
assert all(item["exit"] == 0 for item in gate["host"])
summary = []
for run in matrix["runs"]:
    assert run["passed"] is True and run["source_unchanged"] is True
    directory = local(run["cwd"])
    assert run == json.loads((directory / "result.json").read_bytes())
    assert sha(directory / "serial.txt") == run["serial_sha256"]
    assert sha(directory / "stderr-trace.txt") == run["trace_sha256"]
    assert sha(directory / "data.img") == run["probe_image_sha256_after"]
    assert run["source_image_sha256_before"] == run["source_image_sha256_after"]
    assert run["timed_out"] is False
    lines = (directory / "serial.txt").read_text().splitlines()
    if run["control"]:
        assert run["raw_qemu_exit"] == 33 and run["oracle_generation"] == 84
        assert volume_disk.analyse((directory / "data.img").read_bytes())["generation"] == 84
    else:
        assert run["raw_qemu_exit"] == 35 and run["trace_write_requests"] == 0
        assert run["probe_image_sha256_before"] == run["probe_image_sha256_after"]
        assert lines.count(CORRUPT) == lines.count(STARTUP_FAILURE) == 1
        assert not any(line.startswith(("VOLUME:READY", "VOLUME:APP_", "VOLUME:CASE:", "VOLUME:PASS", "M1:PASS")) for line in lines)
    summary.append({key: run[key] for key in (
        "label", "raw_qemu_exit", "duration_s", "probe_image_sha256_before",
        "probe_image_sha256_after", "serial_sha256", "trace_sha256", "trace_write_requests"
    )})
crashes = []
for stage in gate["stages"]:
    directory = local(stage["run_directory"])
    result = json.loads((directory / "result.json").read_bytes())
    assert stage["passed"] is result["passed"] is True
    assert result["source_sha256"] == SOURCE and result["timed_out"] is False
    assert sha(directory / "volume.after.img") == stage["after_sha256"] == result["after_sha256"]
    assert (directory / "serial.txt").read_bytes() == result["stdout"].replace("\n", "\r\n").encode()
    assert (directory / "stderr.txt").read_bytes() == result["stderr"].replace("\n", "\r\n").encode()
    if stage["case"].startswith("cut-"):
        assert result["host_kill"] is result["running_before_kill"] is True
        assert result["raw_qemu_exit"] == stage["raw_qemu_exit"] == 1
    else:
        assert result["host_kill"] is False and result["raw_qemu_exit"] == 33
    assert controlled(result["stdout"]) == list(expected_markers(stage["case"]))
    assert not any(marker in line for line in result["stdout"].splitlines() for marker in FAILURES)
    assert numbers(result["stdout"]) == result["evidence"]
    if stage["case"] in READ_ONLY:
        assert stage["before_sha256"] == stage["after_sha256"]
    if stage["case"] == "corrupt":
        try:
            volume_disk.analyse((directory / "volume.after.img").read_bytes())
        except ValueError as error:
            assert result["oracle"] == {"refused": str(error)}
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Corrupt snapshot was accepted")
    else:
        oracle = volume_disk.analyse((directory / "volume.after.img").read_bytes())
        check_state(stage["case"], oracle, result["evidence"], result["parent_case"])
    crashes.append({
        **{key: stage[key] for key in ("case", "raw_qemu_exit", "duration_s", "before_sha256", "after_sha256")},
        "host_kill": result["host_kill"],
        "serial_file_sha256": sha(directory / "serial.txt"),
        "stderr_file_sha256": sha(directory / "stderr.txt"),
    })
report = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "date_europe_amsterdam": "2026-11-03",
    "frozen_head": HEAD,
    "source_sha256": SOURCE,
    "source_fingerprint_version": 3,

    "progress": {"previous": 41, "current": 41, "new_points": 0},
}
